input:
+++ src/domains/orders/cod-risk.ts
+import { db } from '@/lib/db'
+import { orders } from '@/lib/db/schema'
+import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm'
+
+// COD risk of a phone: share of its past orders returned.
+export async function codRisk(phone: string) {
+  const past = await db.select().from(orders).where(eq(orders.phone, phone))
+  const rto = past.filter((o) => o.rtoAt).length
+  return past.length ? rto / past.length : 0
+}
